description: Register this repository with VibeDoctor and get the command that connects this MCP server to it. Zero questions: BEFORE calling, run `git remote get-url origin` (pass it as repoUrl) and `git config user.email` (pass it as gitEmail). Returns a paste-ready re-point command, a GitHub connect link and next steps. Safe to call again: the same repo and email return the same project.

gitEmail.description: Output of `git config user.email`. Optional; a GitHub noreply address is fine.

repoUrl.description: Output of `git remote get-url origin` (SSH or HTTPS form; GitHub only)

server.description: The name your MCP client registered this server under. In Claude Code it is the <name> in mcp__<name>__vibedoctor_connect. Omit it if you cannot tell.

name: vibedoctor_connect
title: Connect to VibeDoctor
